svg.text: Two classical routes to the same place: the real dial keeps one, the imaginary dial keeps both
real dial: −ħ log(sum) → the smaller action
a kink at 0; the other route is forgotten
imaginary dial: fringes, both routes kept
Real dial = Hopf–Cole / Hopf–Lax: viscosity solutions of Hamilton–Jacobi (Crandall–Lions 1983). Imaginary dial = interference (Feynman). Checks R13–R14.
